propositions: On autodeploy no-op ticks when root disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) and throttle window has elapsed, docker prune reclaims garbage via prune_docker_caches()
prune_docker_caches() must be relocated from line ~245 to line ~150 (before the no-op exit at line 228) so the function definition precedes its call site

root_disk_pct() helper recomputes disk usage percentage identically to observability.sh:79 and reclaim_under_pressure() throttles reclaim attempts via a persisted timestamp file with PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL (default 600s)
A prune failure on the pressure path logs only and does not alter autodeploy's exit code; an AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker is emitted to stderr exactly once per triggered prune
New tunable config keys (DISK_PRESSURE_PCT, PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL, PRESSURE_PRUNE_TS_FILE) are sourced from /etc/rebar/autodeploy.env and overridable without host redeploy

test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py covers happy path (prune fires at/above threshold), throttle edge case (no second prune within interval), below-threshold no-op, and failure path (docker error does not change exit code)
